content: Nepani mzee: Nukulembe wehapa wa mabhu muhaghulika papamu na bhana bhaku bhanabhapala mu uchakaka. Wala nga nepani pela nenabhapala, nambu bhelabhela bhokapi bhabhaumanyi uchakaka ghola bhumpala mwehapa,
kwa ndandi ja chakaka jela jejitama mkati jitu, na ambaju anajibya papamu na tepani mileli.
Chihomu, chiha, na lukwali, yeihuma kwaka Chapanga Atati na kwaka Yesu Kristo Mwana wa Atati, anaikubha papamu na tepani mu chakaka na upalu.
Nakahekalili namaa kwa kubha nabhaweni bhana bhaku bhakumu bhajenda mu chakaka, ngati bhela Atati moakatulaghalakile.
Sajenu mabhu mpalu, nukulobha: Tupalanaje. Lilobhu lenu nga amuli jahenu, nambu amuli jelajela jetukabhi naju kutumbu pakutumbula.
Na aghoghu nde upalu: Kubha tutamaje kwa kujengalela amuli yaki. Ajeji nde amuli jela, ngati momwajowanile kutumbu pakutumbula, kubha njendaje mu upalu.
Kwa ndandi bhabhakolowa bhamaheli bhahikiki pundema, bhabhakana kubha Yesu Kristo akahikiki kwitu, na hyegha ja kimundu. Mundu joapwagha bhenibhela nde mpuhe na nde mpenga Kristo.
Bhela, mlilingalyaje mabhete ngamughahoa ghala ghamughahengike, nambu njopalyaje nhupu jinu jejikamilike.

Mundu jokapi joajonjuke chindu chokapi na jwangakutamakila mu mabholu ghaka Kristo, ngacheabhi na Chapanga. Nambu mundu jola joatamakila mu mabholu ghanihagha, jonihoju abhi na Atati na Mwana bhelabhela.
Bhela, anangati mundu anahikiki kwinu, najombi ngachealeta mabholu ghani, ngamwanjopalela panyumba jinu, wala ngamwandamukila.
Kwa ndandi joandamukila mundu jonihoju alilomba naku mu matendu mahakau ghaka mundu hoju.
Kwa kubha minaghu ghamaheli gha kundembela, ngachembala kundembe baluwa; nambu nhobhalela kuhika kwinu hoku, na kulongela na mwehapa pamihu kwa pamihu, nahuli chiheku chitu chibya chitimilike.
Bhana bhaka ndombu waku muhaghulika, bhukulamukila.
